Injured while searching for food, Shi Nuo was picked up from a pit by a giant white wolf. He closed his eyes, waiting for death. However, the fangs that should have pierced his throat instead sank into the gland at the back of his neck. The Alpha’s pheromones were injected, causing him to tremble uncontrollably.
The arrival of the only Omega allowed for the release of pent-up pheromones.
Shi Nuo saw the white wolf eating but dared not approach too closely.
Fresh, bloody meat was right before his eyes. He finally received long-awaited meat from the wolf’s mouth.
While Shi Nuo enjoyed his meal, the white wolf lay sleeping on the living room floor.
When night fell, it entered Shi Nuo’s room.
The inherently cold white wolf had no intention of giving anything away. If one wanted food, one had to exchange it for something else.
Later, Shi Nuo’s lower abdomen swelled slightly. He patted his belly, somewhat surprised. How could he have gained weight in such a place?
In the snowy field, the majestic white wolf returned with its prey in its mouth, its icy blue eyes cold and handsome.
Shi Nuo was overjoyed by its return, his eyes filled with delight at the sight of the plump prey. There was meat to eat again, and the price he had to pay for the meat was no longer a concern.
At the dinner table, the tall, sturdy, white-haired man bent the knife and fork in his hand as he watched the Omega, whose eyes held only the image of meat.
Theme: Only by surviving can one witness all that is beautiful. Food will come, and so will love.

98844.synopsis:
“This is an auction to sell a strategic marriage with a set time limit, where I’ll lend my body to bear a legitimate heir.”
Prince Enrique of the small country Shamier is an alpha-dominant Omega born after 200 years. Due to being an alpha-dominant Omega, he faces the prospect of marriage and leaving for another country. There are three husband candidates. Enrique initiates an auction to become king while benefiting his country Shamier without having to leave. He proposes to marry each candidate for 2 years and bear their child. In return, he’ll choose the highest bidder as his first husband.
“Would you please consider me seriously? I sincerely want to be your one and only Alpha.”
For the swift execution of his plan, Enrique never considered Prince Anture of the Ruben Empire, who was still 5 years away from adulthood, as his first husband. Yet somehow, Enrique ends up choosing Anture…

99356.synopsis:
I became a god.
I should create the world I’ve always dreamed of—a utopia where everyone is happy.
With divine blessings, abundant food, and comfortable homes…
I gave generously, holding nothing back.
But these bastards are never satisfied.
Even after giving them everything, they remain ungrateful and full of complaints.
Sigh, you’re all hopeless.
Let’s retrieve it and start over.

99868.synopsis:
The world is approaching destruction.
I must guide the heroes and save this world.
What use are monsters or anything like that?
I have money.
A seriously large amount of money.

101148.synopsis:
After waking up, Bai Tu finds himself transmigrated into a world of furry beastmen. Everyone else can transform into fierce, massive animals, but he’s just an ultra-miniature bunny, so small that his entire body isn’t even as big as someone else’s paw.
To survive, Bai Tu leads his tribe in farming, animal domestication, and infrastructure building, all while occasionally babysitting the wolf cubs sent over by the Wolf King.
But as the saying goes, “Often walking along the river, how can you avoid getting your shoes wet?” After excessively cuddling with the wolves, Bai Tu is eventually snatched away by the neighboring Wolf King. Three months of hard labor later, Bai Tu discovers his belly is getting bigger.
“Don’t panic—it’s fake,” Bai Tu firmly convinces himself that it’s just a phantom pregnancy. But the very next day, as he digs a tunnel to escape, he’s faced with five little wolf cubs by his feet, leaving him utterly speechless and on the verge of tears.
Reading Guide:
Black Wolf Gong (top) × White Bunny Shou (bottom)
The story focuses heavily on farming and world-building in the early chapters.
Later chapters include mpreg (male pregnancy), with the five wolf cubs consisting of sons and nephews.

101404.synopsis:
“Why not just have a child? What’s the point of planting seeds if nothing grows from them?”
Eliano Rosana, known as the “lofty flower on the cliff,” was a noblewoman. She was forced to marry the enemy nation and became their empress, but then she was abandoned by her family and husband, leading to a sad end.
Everything went wrong.
When she woke up again, she found herself back in the past. This time, she promised herself she would never marry that man.
Then she noticed the Northern Duke, Flint Howard.
She thought he was tough and not easily swayed. But suddenly, he kidnapped her.
“I have desires too. You won’t regret what happens tonight.”

101916.synopsis:
Set in the year 2054, thirty years have passed since mysterious “rifts” began appearing on Earth in 2024. These rifts pull in objects (and sometimes people) and then, 20 days later, unleash monsters.
Humanity has fought back with “Hunters,” awakened individuals capable of effectively battling monsters. Over time, the world has adapted to these rifts, even creating hunting grounds from them. However, an unprecedented one-meter-tall, black-colored rift—never before recorded—appears in Korea’s Taebaek Mountains.
Its power level surpasses even known S-rank rifts. S-rank Hunter and top rift researcher Sung Yumi and her newly assigned assistant Kim Ina investigate, realizing that something (or someone) must have been pulled inside since the rift remains closed. If that person does not survive, once the rift reopens and 20 days elapse, catastrophic monsters may emerge and potentially destroy the country.
Meanwhile, Ji Yeonwoo, a struggling F-rank Hunter, has come to the same mountains to hunt “armored roe deer” for income. After a falling-out with his team, he’s forced to camp outdoors, unaware that a deadly new rift looms nearby.

102172.synopsis:
“Let’s say you did it. Understood?”
Once again, Harriet couldn’t argue with her uncle’s decision to pin the blame on her for the trouble her cousin Bella had caused. After all, she was an orphan, living under the care of her guardian, her uncle.
Even though she became known as a scandal maker in society, even though people gossiped behind her back, Harriet believed that at least her uncle’s family would understand her sacrifice.
That was until she was accused of stealing the duke’s brooch and sent away to the strict convent, known for its harsh discipline.
“A scandal maker? Fine. If that’s what they want to call me, I’ll become a real scandal maker.” 
With revenge in her heart, Harriet returned to the city, only to find herself face-to-face with Duke Kaylas, the man who had been the reason she was sent to the convent.
“They say people change after coming back from St. Clarissa’s convent. I guess it’s true.”
His cold, piercing eyes shone with a dangerous curiosity, almost as if he were suspicious.

102684.synopsis:
“If I shove mine in here again today, will my wife break?”
Floria, the unloved princess, was married off like a mere commodity to the ruthless tyrant, Aidan.
As the rumors said, the man was rough and unyielding.
The wedding night.
With a brute force, he grabbed her delicate waist and mercilessly thrust inside. His muscles, which smacked against her hips, were as hard as stone. Soft flesh was pressed and crushed, birthing both pleasure and pain in tandem.
“I never knew women were such fragile creatures.”
In the hands that had been stained with the blood of countless people, anything would easily crumble.
“And I never knew you would drive me this insane.”
Every time he moved his hips, her entire body felt as if it were shattering. A clear liquid trickled down between her pale thighs. Overwhelmed by the pleasure she never even knew she possessed, Floria dug her nails into Aidan’s rock-hard body and pleaded.
“Please… Spare me, Aidan.”
“I don’t intend to break you.”
At her pleasure-tinged plea, the man let out a low laugh.
“After all, I worked too hard to have you—how could I possibly kill you?”

104476.synopsis:
Shen Qing was infamous in his village as a fierce ger who no one wanted to marry. After being “kicked out” of his home alongside his mother by his biased grandparents and a father who was desperate for a son, he had no choice but to make a living by selling firewood.
One day, while chopping wood in the mountains, he encountered a wild boar. In a panic, he fled into a cave, only to discover that on the other side of the cave was an entirely different world.
This world was overrun with decaying zombies, mutated animals, and strange plants-but what caught Shen Qing’s eye was the shimmering gold, silver, jewelry, antique jade, and luxury watches spread out on a street market stall…
And the price? Just one steamed bun.
Clutching a sack full of buns, Shen Qing swallowed hard. He wasn’t just interested in the treasures at the stall-he also had his eye on the handsome, foolish-looking man squatting behind the table with clear, naive eyes.
…
Song Kaiji had struggled for nearly a year in the apocalypse, tirelessly searching for his lost family members. Every day, he set up a stall at the flea market, hoping to gather news.
Unexpectedly, a moment of kindness led to an unexpected windfall-not only did someone finally buy the “junk” he’d been hoarding, but he also latched onto a golden thigh (backer), got himself a wealthy sponsor, and soared to the top of his life.
“Everything on this stall-gold, jewelry, jade—all for just two catties of rice! Two catties of rice, and you won’t regret it! Two catties of rice, and you won’t be scammed!”
“What about the stall owner? Are you for sale?”
“Limited edition. Only available for Shen Qing.”
After the rain clears, the sky stretches endless and blue.
Reading Guide:
1. The cave connects two worlds. The protagonist travels between them, with the primary setting in ancient times and the secondary in the apocalypse.
2. Alternate universe. The ancient world consists of three genders: men, ger, and women. The protagonist is a ger, and there will be mpreg (male pregnancy) later.

104732.synopsis:
Shen Xiling was once like a golden thread grass clinging to Qi Jingchen for survival. He gave her life, education, and even love.
Shen Xiling once thought this man was omnipotent, until one day disaster struck, and she watched helplessly as Qi Jingchen fell from the clouds into the mire. Even at that moment, he was still trying every means to protect her, eventually sending her under someone else’s wings.
Ten years later when they met again, shattered mountains and rivers and tangled marriages stood between them, creating countless barriers. This time, it was finally Shen Xiling’s turn to hold up the lotus leaf, sheltering the man who always cherished her like a treasure from wind and rain.
When the mountains and rivers are stabilized, let us watch the lotuses rise together in the wind.

104988.synopsis:
All of humanity has been transported into a series of doomsday apartments!
Everyone awakens unique abilities and struggles to survive within their apartments.
Jiang Ye and his classmates happen to be sent to the same beginner’s apartment!
Classmate A: “Everyone, listen up! I awakened an S-tier ability!”
Classmate B: “That’s amazing! An S-tier ability—we’re saved!”
Classmate C: “We’re all classmates; we should help each other!”
Classmate D: “An S-tier powerhouse! Lead us to victory!”
Jiang Ye awakens an X-tier ability—Infinite Replication.
However, his first replica only has a C-tier ability.
Among his classmates, he seems utterly unremarkable.
But soon, he discovers—
Every single replica he creates comes with its own ability!
And these replicas can be merged back into his original body!
In other words, Infinite Replication = Infinite Abilities!
But things get even crazier!
While his classmates struggle to fight monsters and level up, they sometimes encounter terrifying, supernatural creatures—creepy beings that send shivers down their spines.
Yet Jiang Ye notices something odd—
These entities love to imitate humans.
And whenever they disguise themselves as him, his X-tier ability, “Infinite Replication,” automatically recognizes them as his replicas.
Which means—they fall under his control!
So—
While his classmates are still grinding through battles step by step, Jiang Ye is directly absorbing the supernatural creatures into his army of replicas!
One day, Jiang Ye looks into the mirror.
The “him” in the reflection suddenly grins eerily.
So, Jiang Ye grins back.
“Hey there—nice to meet you, my new replica. :)”
associated_names: 末日公寓求生，而我无限分身！

105756.synopsis:
You Ye started acting at the age of 12, praised by the media as a “genius experiential actor,” with no role he couldn’t master.
For You Ye, acting was life itself, but on his 27th birthday, he encountered an accident on his way to the film set.
On the brink of death, the birthday song and the cold voice of the system echoed—
“Welcome to the [Patient Interpretation] system.”
“Only by perfectly interpreting the role of the [patient] in each world and gaining the approval of the behind-the-scenes director can you regain your life.”
“We regret to inform you that the director randomly matched to you is quite perverse; no one has successfully navigated his storyline to date.”
You Ye felt no turmoil within, even laughing: “I also regret to inform this director that his record is about to be broken.”
Thus, he perfectly portrayed the “sickly vase artist craving human blood,” the “defective robot that cries when touched,” and the “psychiatrist searching for his missing second personality”…
He was both an actor and a patient.
He brought to life the contradictory yet captivating roles with great flair.
…
In a parallel world, You Ye died in an accident eighteen years ago.
After his death, he worked in the quick-transmigration world, personally building the [Patient Interpretation] system, code-named 202.
Only by encountering an actor who belongs to him, perfectly interpreting the roles he set, can 202 return to the past, erase regrets, and fulfill wishes.
202 waited for eighteen years and finally met his chosen actor on his birthday.
But he did not know the other’s identity—another version of himself from a parallel world.
202 made a cameo in the script, meeting himself in different worlds, performing together.
Then they fell in love and revealed their true selves.
You Ye: Sorry, I’m a bit narcissistic.
202: What a coincidence, so am I.
Consumption Guide:
Self-attack and self-receive variant, parallel universe type self-attack and self-receive, with different death times and events for the protagonists in the two worlds;
The roles interpreted may not follow the order in the synopsis and may be modified; everything is subject to the main text;
A self-exploratory work, non-typical quick-transmigration, with elements of fantasy, infinite flow, and suspense;
One-sentence Summary: Acting with oneself in a parallel world.
Theme: Those who love their careers are truly remarkable.

107804.synopsis: I have become a giant and dangerous calamity of the desert.

108316.synopsis:
“””Please help me get together with your childhood friend!!”””
It’s been 20 years since I was reincarnated as a background extra who didn’t even appear in that tr*shy dating sim game.
After barely managing to secure the coveted role of the protagonist’s childhood friend, the heroines started approaching me. They asked me to help them get together with the male protagonist.
In the end, for the sake of my comfortable future, I agreed to become their love consultant (for a small “fee” of course) and help them find love.
But as time went on… the way they looked at me was starting to feel a little off…?
associated_names: I Was Just an Extra, but Became the Heroines' Love Manager

108828.synopsis: Things in life don’t always work out easily, and it seemed like that was the case for me too.

110364.synopsis:
Ji Taoyu has lived with abnormally heightened senses since childhood, every sensation feels magnified. A spring drizzle or gentle breeze can send him to bed with fever, earning him a reputation as the village’s most delicate flower.
Fortunately, his parents secured his future early, betrothing him to a promising match. His fiance’s family was well-established, and the young man himself was a scholar. Though they weren’t deeply in love, they treated each other with respect.
Everyone in the village agreed it was a good match.  
When the time came for Ji Taoyu to marry, his fiance’s family abruptly broke off the engagement. 
Overnight, Ji Taoyu went from being the envy of the village to its laughingstock. Even with his good looks and decent family, no worthy suitors remained.  
Ji Taoyu spent his days with red-rimmed eyes, until even the rough, taciturn newcomer mocked him: “Were you a crybaby in your past life? Was he really the only one for you?”  
Ji Taoyu lowered his gaze. “Who said he was the only one? It’s just that no one will marry me now!”
Huo Shu was born in the northern frontier. Drafted into military service as a teen, he fought on the battlefield until the war ended.
Weary of battle, he declined official honors and instead traveled to Jiangnan’s lush landscapes—a world away from the desert’s harsh winds. 
There, he spotted a jade-skinned, doe-eyed beauty… only to learn the young ger was already promised to another.
Just as he resigned himself to regret, news came that the engagement had been broken. Without hesitation, Huo Shu seized his chance: “I’ll marry you.”
associated_names: The Husband is a Delicate Flower

110620.synopsis:
The zombie virus outbreak throws the world into chaos. After the Blood Moon, everyone awakens special abilities, but Ji Chuan finds himself unchanged!
Betrayed and driven out by his girlfriend’s family, Ji Chuan, besieged by zombies, can only resign himself to despair and falls. When Ji Chuan wakes up, he discovers he has become a zombie but retains his consciousness.
It turns out his special ability is actually the Zombie King, only usable after becoming a zombie.
This world gradually becomes unfamiliar. Unknown creatures, fantastical special abilities, Gates of Unusual Activity—it seems a greater secret is about to be unveiled…
***
The world drowned in chaos when the zombie virus struck, but for Ji Chuan, the true horror began after the fall. Having survived the initial outbreak in his parents’ secluded villa, his compassion became his downfall. Answering the desperate pleas of his girlfriend, Su Wanwan, he braved the undead hordes to rescue her and her family, bringing them to safety.
But when the Red Moon granted powers to humanity, Ji Chuan awakened nothing. Deemed useless, he was brutally betrayed – cast out by Su Wanwan and her secret lover, Liu Hao, left broken and bleeding outside his own sanctuary. Bitten and left for dead, Ji Chuan expected oblivion.
Instead, he awoke. His body was monstrous, decaying, yet his mind remained sharp. A horrifying realization dawned: he was a zombie, but one unlike any other. He was the Zombie King, possessing the unique ability to sense and consume the crystal cores embedded within the undead, absorbing their powers and growing stronger with each kill. Fueled by the chilling memory of betrayal and an insatiable hunger for power, Ji Chuan embarks on a dark path of vengeance in a world teetering on the brink. He is the monster they created, and now, he’s coming back for them.

110876.synopsis:
I possessed a character—a witch—destined to be burned at the stake by the very boy she ab*sed, who would later grow up to become a tyrant.
By the time I realized my situation, the boy’s stepmother—soon to disappear from the story—had already dumped the budding tyrant into my care.
“Commission poison for him? Use him for your experiments…?”
Sure, the original witch might have hated humans, but me? I’m just an ordinary person who wants to live a long, quiet life!
Sigh. Fine. I couldn’t risk sending the little tyrant-to-be to another witch who might actually ab*se him. The best I could do was raise him until he was old enough to fend for himself—and ensure he returned to the palace without getting too attached to me in the meantime.
Thus, I played my role half-heartedly, scolding him just enough to keep him wary but never actually mistreating him.
“You filthy little rat! Stay out of my lab! What are you lurking around here for with that grimy body of yours?”
“Wait, you’re bleeding… Don’t touch it! Fine, I’ll draw a bath for you. Just shut up, make sure there are lots of bubbles, and play with the duck while you wash up!”
And so, I raised the little tyrant with only words of scorn and seven years of reluctant care. And true to the original story, the would-be tyrant eventually escaped the forest and returned to the palace.
Six years later, news reached me that he had fully matured into the fearsome tyrant he was destined to be. Well, as long as he becomes a proper K-tyrant and works hard for the prosperity of our region, it’ll all work out, I thought.
But then, one fateful day…
“Arrest this witch,” came his cold command.
…The tyrant came for me, just as in the original story.
But instead of taking me to the stake, he brought me to his chambers.
“Lilithea,” he said, his deep voice curling around my name.
And instead of condemning me to flames, he issued a different kind of sentence.
“Now it’s your turn. You won’t take a single step outside this house, and you’ll live exactly as I command.”
“What…?”
“You always called me filthy, didn’t you?” His lips twisted into a smirk.
“W-wait!”
“Now, you’ll find out firsthand what filth really is.”
That night, I learned the meaning of fire and ruin—not from the stake, but from the tyrant himself. It was a night of consuming heat, where bone and flesh burned in a rapture I could neither escape nor endure…

112668.synopsis:
“Holy crap, running into Tang San right at the start! Blast him!”
“Don’t think you’re all that just because you’re in the sky — you still need to be dealt with! Piss off Tang San once, piss him off twice…”
Ming Hui: “Yuhao, why not join my sect? Ahem… I mean, come work for me…”
“Tang the Great God-King is acting up again! Junior Brother, go sacrifice yourself—good job! As expected of Tang San’s exclusive succubus — the ultimate damage sponge! Absolutely terrifying!”
Tang San: “Ming Hui, you’ve ruined my plans. You’re asking for death!”
Tang Wutong: “Ming Hui, you profiteering capitalist! You’re not even human!
Huo Yuhao! Are you his dog or something? Why are you so obedient?!”
Huo Yuhao: “Senior Brother Ming Hui is actually a really nice guy.”
Ming Hui: “Yeah yeah, of course! I believe in the Goddess of Life  I’m a very good person… Wait, I’ve ascended? Great! Now the tables have turned!”
Tang San, your death is sealed!

116764.synopsis:
Lu Yao binds with a “Dream Fulfillment System” from another world.
By continuously opening stores in parallel universes, she can eventually realize one wish.
Soon, a once-abandoned shopping street in the city quietly undergoes a transformation.
While the shops appear ordinary in the current world, they connect to parallel dimensions in alternate realities.
• A snack shop, nail salon, blind box store, fluffy pet café, interdimensional cinema, and even a childhood tutoring center— Lu Yao’s shopping street boasts an array of stores, with more yet to
come.
In the primordial ancient world, a hot spring inn suddenly appears at the edge of the world, becoming a paradise for a tribe of thumb-sized people.
In the cracks of the cultivation realm, a peculiar store called
“Interdimensional Internet Café” pops up, attracting beings from across the six realms to linger and enjoy its offerings.
Eventually, even the most prestigious Immortal-Demon Conference relocates to this small shop.
The zombie apocalypse, galactic worlds, virtual realities, and mythical divine realms- every store Lu Yao opens in these alternate worlds becomes wildly popular.
Yet, her warehouse is overflowing with unsellable items like infinite-time space rings, magical gemstones, natural slimming herbs, and scent-detecting phones… but not a single coin to show for it.
Lu Yao laments: “I’m almost out of money to stock up…”
System: [Ding! Host has completed an S-rank mission. Unlock a spatial pocket in the current world. Open a new shop?] Lu Yao: “Current world? As in the one I live in?”
System: [Yes.] 
Lu Yao: “Can I sell the junk in my warehouse?”
System: [As long as someone is willing to buy it.] 
Soon after, Lu Yao’s latest venture— a cross-dimensional general store — opens for business.
This one operates as an online shop.
A middle schooler stumbles upon the store online, curious about a space ring for sale. His friends laugh at him for falling for a scam.
Days later, the boy receives his package and follows the instructions. A one-cubic-meter space unfolds before his eyes.
Lu Yao’s general store explodes in popularity!
And at the end of this journey lies…
Reading Guide
1. Another adventure in managing limitless shops. Complete AU setting with original world-building.
2. Slow-paced daily management, not a big “girl boss” style power trip.
3. Includes romance (BG, 1v1). More prominent love story than in the first part-readers who dislike CPs, beware.
associated_names: 异世界商店街经营指南二

117788.synopsis:
In a pure martial world, Yun Shou thought he’d live an ordinary life with his weak little cheat…
Until the year he turned fourteen, when a second, flawed simulator landed in his hands.
What he didn’t expect was—when the two cheats combined, he became invincible!
After a hurried few years (well, not that long really), Yun Shou suddenly looked back—
He was already a Martial Emperor of the era, reigning supreme across all time and space, transcending the ages!
associated_names: 模拟加熬命，出世已无敌

119324.synopsis:
I’m obsessed with zombie stories. Truly.
If I ever woke up in the middle of a zombie apocalypse, I was fairly certain I’d be just fine.
As in, I’d survive. As a human, obviously.
That was the plan, anyway…
***
Um… just wondering, but do I look like a zombie to you?
“Grr… grrr grrrk?”
The machete guy gave his weapon a quick shake and narrowed his eyes at me.
“This one’s pretty chatty.”
Right. So much for that plan.
Who the hell expects to reincarnate as a zombie?

119580.synopsis:
After ninety-nine lifetimes of reincarnation, Ling Yun, who kept transmigrating as the villain of this world, still failed to defy the heavens and change his fate.
He wanted to save his junior brothers and sisters, save his master, save the sect, and save the world. Resolutely, he chose to become a true villain, to oppose the Child of Destiny. Yet in the end, he still died by their hands.
Since that’s how it is, he decided to quit being the villain and escape. The world is so vast—I want to go see it for myself.
He wanted to see for himself: without him, the villain, what kind of path would these so-called Children of Destiny take?
As for his junior brothers and sisters, his master, the sect, and even the entire world… he could only say one thing—good luck to you all.

120860.synopsis:
Rong Shi had always been a prodigy—handsome, ruthless, brilliant in combat, and promoted to Major General before the age of thirty. He was widely acknowledged as a top-tier Alpha. But a sudden entanglement in political power struggles, and his refusal to accept a forced match, landed him in prison.
When he opened his eyes again, he had returned to the age of eighteen.
Looking at the freshly delivered acceptance letter, he decided to keep a low profile and investigate the truth behind everything.
At the opening ceremony, Rong Shi’s single sentence—
“I’m just here to kill time.”
—caused an uproar.
Rumors of cheating on the entrance exam, being a worthless coward, and being the son of a deserter spread like wildfire across the military academy.
He thought he was already low-key enough—but Omega students kept stopping him to confess their love.
“I like Alphas,” Rong Shi said lazily, pointing into the crowd.
“Especially the beautiful and s**tty kind.”
Song Yu: “???”
As the Empire’s second prince, Song Yu had always outshone the crown prince. To avoid being too eye-catching, he enrolled in the military academy under a hidden identity.
On his very first day, a ridiculously handsome Alpha confessed to him.
Song Yu: “Sure, let’s get married.”
Rong Shi: “???”
Omegas: “?!!!”
During a simulated battle, Rong Shi’s team was nearly wiped out. At the last second, he pulled out his blade and turned the tide.
Teammates: “Holy sh*t! You’re actually a boss?!”
Rong Shi passed by, face cold: “An accident.”
#I didn’t mean to do it. My hands moved on their own.#
Rong Shi had a white moonlight he’d never met before and always imagined them as a sweet, cute Omega.
Wanting to make up for the regrets of his previous life, he decided to finally meet them in person.
[Lil Rich O, wanna meet up?] 
Right after he sent the message, he heard Song Yu’s terminal chime.
Song Yu glanced at it, leaned in, and asked,
“Hey, what do you need to watch out for when meeting an Omega IRL?”
Rong Shi: “…He might not want to meet you anymore.”
associated_names: 老婆是顶级Alpha，我该怎么办

124700.synopsis:
After reincarnating into the tragic novel A Bird Trapped in a Cage, Winterbelle instinctively knew—
She had come here to save the boy who was destined to become a broken male lead, ruined by ab*se and divorce.
“The monster won’t come. I’ll stay by your side until you fall asleep.”
And so, she rescued the child from ab*se and poured all her overflowing love into him.
She believed that once she reconciled with her husband returning from war and prevented the divorce, everything would be over.
But—
“Why I dislike you? I simply don’t love you. Isn’t that enough?”
“This contract doesn’t impose any obligations on me. Don’t forget—even spending the night with you is just an act of courtesy on my part.”
“You were better before. At least then, you were cruel—not pathetic.”
Clifford’s hatred for Winterbelle ran far deeper than she expected.
So, Winterbelle made him an offer:
One year.
After that, she would cleanly agree to the divorce.
•• ━━━━━ ••●•• ━━━━━ ••
During the year granted by the contract, Winterbelle tried desperately to win Clifford’s heart.
But—
“Do you really… not love Ed?”
To her final question, asked with the last shred of hope she had left, no answer ever came.
Only then did Winterbelle accept the painful truth she had tried to ignore all along.
She had to leave her husband.
•• ━━━━━ ••●•• ━━━━━ ••
Finally, the day marking the end of their promised marriage arrived.
She went to him kindly, thinking he’d be waiting for this moment.
“The contract you proposed is over.”
“……”
“But there was no clause saying I’d still want a divorce once it ended.”
His attitude had changed.
“Give me a chance too, Winterbelle.”

124956.synopsis:
